source_title: THE BREADWINNER Get it Now on Blu-ray™, DVD, and Digital
source_excerpt:
Starring comedian Nate Bargatze as salesman Nate Wilcox and Mandy Moore as his wife, Katie. To Nate and their three children, Katie is the ultimate mom. But when her household invention leads to a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank and takes her on a prolonged business trip, Nate must figure out how to keep the house from (literally) falling apart. Welcome to the dad era.​
